result.question: What were Nvidia's total assets at the end of its latest fiscal year?
result.answer: NVIDIA's total assets at the end of its latest fiscal year (fiscal year 2026, ending January 25, 2026) were approximately $206.8 billion, reported as $206,803 million on its Consolidated Balance Sheet [0001045810-26-000021:item-15-p006]. This figure is also confirmed by the XBRL-tagged total assets value of 206,803,000,000 USD as of January 25, 2026 [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:Assets:2026-01-25].
